data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 165,799k (2016 - GBP 121,917k) is a deterioration of GBP 11,547k (2016 - deterioration of GBP 6,859k) to the claims reserves established at the prior year end, principally due to natural catastrophes (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico Earthquake and Californian Wildfires) and adverse attritional development in prior year reserves on the Property and Marine classes.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Improvement on the Liability class driven by the release of the 2016 Ogden margin resulting in favourable claims development

prior_year_events.event_name: Closure of 2015 Year of Account (reinsured to 2016)
prior_year_events.impact_description: The 2015 year closed at a loss of GBP 16,247k following a calendar year loss of GBP 10,113k and a brought-forward retained loss after 24 months of GBP 6,134k

named_events.event_name: Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and Mexico earthquakes
named_events.loss_description: The Syndicate's reinsurance programme, including its participation on the group catastrophe programme, significantly ameliorated the impact with net losses totalling $22,359k (GBP 16,546k). These losses triggered reinstatements premium with the acceleration of the earning of the catastrophe excess of loss protection further impacting the results.
The Californian Wildfires further deteriorated the Property account with net losses of $8,248k (GBP 6,104k) incurred at the year end.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 were GBP 353.514m. During 2017 there was a net adverse prior-year development on gross claims of approximately GBP 20.956m (circa 5.9% of opening reserves), driven principally by natural catastrophe events (notably hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and the Mexico earthquakes, and Californian wildfires) and adverse attritional/large loss development primarily on the Property and Marine portfolios. This adverse movement was partially offset by favourable development on the Liability class driven by the release of the 2016 Ogden margin.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 165,799k (2016 - GBP 121,917k) is a deterioration of GBP 11,547k (2016 - deterioration of GBP 6,859k) to the claims reserves established at the prior year end, principally due to natural catastrophes (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico Earthquake and Californian Wildfires) and adverse attritional development in prior year reserves on the Property and Marine classes.
The loss in the year is the combination of several factors including material exposure to hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and the Mexico earthquakes particularly on the Property account.
The Californian Wildfires further deteriorated the Property account with net losses of $8,248k (GBP 6,104k) incurred at the year end.
Large loss activity on the Marine and Special Lines classes, and adverse attritional loss development on the Property and Marine lines further deteriorated the results.
Losses were partially offset by an improvement on the Liability class driven by the release of the 2016 Ogden margin as well as favourable claims development in the year.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development gross figure was computed from the gross claims development triangle (note 20) because the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note (note 7) reports a deterioration figure (GBP 11,547k) in the context of net claims incurred and appears to be net of reinsurance. The triangle-derived gross PYD is ~GBP 20.956m. Users should note this difference: note 7's GBP 11,547k appears to be a net figure; the triangle provides gross movement. All triangle numbers were read from the report's gross claims development table (figures are in GBP '000).
